BiblicalUsage: Saraph appears once, in the genealogy of Judah, among the ancient men of Chozeba: Jokim, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. His name sits beside a single fact — that he ruled in Moab — and nothing more is told of him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a one-line name like this belongs in the record, because God keeps the names of men the world forgets.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
